newsitem.title: ITALY: Banco di Napoli Q1 net profit 4.6 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Banco di Napoli Q1 net profit 4.6 bln lire.

text.p: Italy's troubled Banco di Napoli said on Tuesday that its first quarter 1997 net profit was 4.6 billion lire and said that was a reverse of the previous, loss-making trend.
The bank gave results in a statement that included no comparative figures for the corresponding 1996 period.
It provided the following data for the three months ended March 31, 1996:
* Net interest income 439.7 billion, down 2.5 percent
* Operating profit 140.4 billion, in line with Q1
The statement said the results "represent a first signal of management re-equilibrium, in line with objectives to return to breakeven."
